'''Ostega''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Civil war on Ostega|civil war]] occurred on this planet before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
